mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months triggers a short-term equity sell-off due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months following two consecutive months of FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for two consecutive months signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 105), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals an overheating labor market that triggers Fed tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 1.3 million units signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST above 1.3 million units.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months following two consecutive months of INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 300 and decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 690,000 million dollars signals a stagflationary environment that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300 and RSAFS < 690000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 690,000 million dollars for two consecutive months signals weak consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months following two consecutive months of RSAFS < 690000.
